rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides programmatic access to Keycloak's Admin REST API using service account credentials via the Client Credentials Grant flow, eliminating the need for user passwords or session-based authentication. Covers user management, group operations, security monitoring, event analytics, and session and client management across Keycloak realms. Includes 24 tools spanning user search and password resets, brute force detection, login failure analysis, session statistics, and SAML/OIDC client enumeration.
